roleTitle: Principal Data Engineer, Plant Data Platform
jobDescription: Fourteen manufacturing plants stream sensor and production data into the plant data platform, and the analytics and maintenance teams build on what it serves. The Principal Data Engineer is the platform's design authority: owns the reference architecture the ingestion and serving teams implement, chairs the platform's technical standards group, sits on the company's engineering review board for the platform, and coaches the senior engineers of both teams. Candidates must already have held a design-authority or principal role spanning more than one team. Reports to the head of manufacturing data; works with the ingestion team, the serving team, the review board and the plant IT managers.
requirements: Has held a design-authority or principal role spanning more than one engineering team.
Owns the reference architecture that other teams implement and has sat on an engineering review board for a platform.
Chairs a technical standards group under a documented standards process.
Coaches senior engineers under a documented coaching programme.
Records what each architecture decision and each standard leaves open.

evidence.text: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for the plant data platform of an industrial manufacturer since 2023, spanning the ingestion team and the serving team; senior data engineer on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.

Owner of the platform's reference architecture, implemented by both teams, and holder of the platform's seat on the company's engineering review board, where the six architecture proposals of the last three years were presented under my name; the proposals and the board minutes are in the architecture repository.
Chaired the platform's technical standards group, which met fortnightly under the group's standards process and issued eleven standards in that period, each with a change record.
Coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
Recorded in each architecture proposal and each standard what it left open, in the 'not decided here' section that the standards process requires.

Work sample: two architecture proposals with their review board minutes, two standards with their change records and one coaching agreement, with the architecture repository references as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he has been the platform's design authority since 2023, spanning both teams, and that the review board proposals were presented under his name; the account matches the resume.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of manufacturing data asks the packet to cite the proposals by repository reference and the board minutes, and to show the senior engineer years separately from the principal years.

propositions.text: The candidate has been the Principal Data Engineer and design authority for an industrial manufacturer's plant data platform since 2023, spanning the ingestion and serving teams, after a senior data engineer role on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the principal role and the periods.

propositions.rationale: The resume, the proposals and the board minutes document the architecture ownership, the board seat and the standards group.

propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the coaching and the open-items sections.
